name: GlassSurface-TS-TW
title: GlassSurface
blurb: A glassy container with chromatic aberration and blur that distorts the…
description: A glass-morphism container using SVG displacement mapping and chromatic aberration to create realistic optical refraction effects. Adapts to light/dark mode with automatic fallback for browsers lacking SVG filter support.
use_when: You want a premium frosted-glass effect around text or UI elements with optical distortion that refracts the background.
avoid_when: Older browsers or environments where SVG filters are unsupported.
a11y: Container only; focus and keyboard behavior depend on children. No motion guards.
